scope: G10 synthetic Skill acceptance review page-to-database test on existing ma11 replay clone

findingAndFix.cause: Inference from the same-origin browser request, the 403, and the successful Host-aware fix: the request URL origin differed from the browser-facing Host origin.
findingAndFix.fix: Accept an Origin matching either the request URL origin or its protocol plus Host, while rejecting cross-site and same-site browser POSTs.

limits: The browser used a synthetic account, source task, Skill, and evidence bundle. The test's human reviewer kind is the API identity, not an independent human quality judgment.
The UI-generated judgments were removed from the clone before the original fixture continued and its remaining cleanup completed.
Safety and prospective-shadow material, natural business quality, automatic enablement, production deployment and rollback are not accepted by this result.
